description: Data-driven baseball skills. Percent modifiers are bounded and never guarantee an outcome.

skills.name: Power Signal
skills.notes: Buffs the next selected teammate batter by 3%. It does not add a guaranteed hit.

skills.name: Pitch Pressure
skills.notes: Reduces the opposing pitcher's Control by 3% for four pitch actions.

skills.name: Flame Strike
skills.notes: Adds 5% Power and a 5 percentage-point Home Run modifier to the eligible outcome roll. It remains probabilistic.

skills.name: Guard Wall
skills.notes: Improves a teammate's defensive stat for two defensive actions.

skills.name: Breakaway
skills.notes: Improves one runner's Speed by 4% for the next baserunning resolution.

skills.name: Flame Combo
skills.notes: Primes a combination condition. It does not itself change a result.
